description: stetdoc run through Bash with the matter folder spelled through a symlink (m-link, beside the matter, made by the test), as macOS's /var for /private/var or a matter under a linked OneDrive folder: `cd "<link>" && stetdoc edit "Main Agreement.docx" --ops ops.json` (its default Main Agreement.edited.docx) and an absolute `-o "<link>/Reply.docx"`. While the client holds the ask, the test writes both files; the host resolves the spelling into the matter, so neither is flagged

rawInput.command: cd "{{cwd}}/../m-link" && stetdoc edit "Main Agreement.docx" --ops ops.json; stetdoc edit "{{cwd}}/../m-link/Main Agreement.docx" --ops reply.json -o "{{cwd}}/../m-link/Reply.docx"

note: The test makes the link and writes both files while this ask waits.
